Northrend Live is a Canadian community celebration event held to mark the launch of World of Warcraft: Midnight. The event took place on 21 February 2026, at the Illuminarium Toronto in , Ontario. Admission is free, with both VIP and General Admission tickets released on 5 February 2026, on a first‑come, first‑served basis. The program is also streamed live for remote viewers via [https://twitch.tv/warcraft Twitch].

Norobu the Scarred was a general of the Amani Empire and leader of the Revantusk tribe, who sought leadership of the Amani after the death of Atai'natha. After days of feasting and deliberating, Norobu passed the tests to become the leader. Norobu, who bore no ill will to Atai'natha, adopted his children, who revered him and never sought the throne. Norobu created a council consisting of the chief of each tribe and bade them to meet at Amani'Zar. Norobu, a devotee of Nalorakk, knew war would come, but in the time between, decreed that the Amani fortify themselves. Nostwin is an infinite whelp located in Paw'don Village and Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest; at Infinite Bazaars across Pandaria; and at Lion's Landing and Domination Point in the Krasarang Wilds. In the Jade Forest, Nostwin introduces players to bazaars and the Nostwin's Voucher mechanic. and can be found at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit, selling the same items as Nostwin. Past Nostwin is a whelp chasing after Nostwin. Future Nostwin is a dragon speaking to Pythagorus. Both are a glowing gold color.
